lines.en: I have no need to walk
I sit firmly where I am placed
I was set down here
I never shift my spot
I stay in one place only
The floor holds me and I do not move
My legs are table legs
I have no feet to step with
I wait here to be struck
I wait here for training to begin
I have not moved an inch
I stand here to be used
My top is bare
I wait for the next blow
My surface is very flat
An old mark crosses me
I neither speak nor move
My wood creaks softly
I stand in the middle of the floor
I am counting the hits so far
A little dust has settled on me
I do not tire at all
I'm counting the hits I took today.
My legs have pressed shallow dents
There is nothing else for me
I wait for the next digimon
You can use me too
You lean down over my tabletop.
I am waiting for a hand
You are looking at my top
I do not answer, just use me
It is fine if you come close
I have my purpose
You have no digimon with you
I am only a table

lines.zh: 我在这间屋子里很久了
lines.en: I have been in this room a long time

lines.zh: 你碰我一下我也没反应
lines.en: Touch me and nothing happens
I wait for someone to start
A line joins my top
My top rocks once
A leg scrapes the floor
That damage is nothing
I settle back into place
A small split opens in the wood
I am still here
I keep waiting to be struck
I have not come apart
That one was still light
A table never needs to eat
You set something on my top
That is not my purpose
You have put it in the wrong place
I eat nothing; put it elsewhere.
You may as well take it away
I am only a table
It may stay, but it does nothing
I do not store things here
Just take it with you
You hit my table leg
I rock once and steady
Nothing falls from my top
My legs are solid
You hurt your own foot
I shift half an inch
That force will not move me
I am still in my old spot
A little dust rises at my feet
I settle once you step back
A table needs no company

lines.zh: 我在这儿就是为了被用
lines.en: I am here to be used

lines.zh: 我一张桌子不该谈这些
lines.en: As a table, I shouldn't be asked such things.
That has nothing to do with me
I am only a table
I still have to wait to be trained on
I have no answer ready
I go on standing there
I was merely placed here
Such things should not be asked of me

lines.zh: 这物件从我面上滑下去
lines.en: The thing slides right off my top.
Things are placed on my top
My top is empty; I can't gather it up.
It just sits here on me
I neither keep nor give
Just take it
I am only a resting place

lines.zh: 东西放在我面上没人拿
lines.en: Something sits on me and nobody takes it.
I can hold it, not carry it
Just lay it on me

lines.zh: 你的拳头落在我桌面上
lines.en: Your fist lands on my tabletop.
There was force in that
I have recorded that point
You may strike again
I am here to be hit
How did that one feel
I do not mean to strike back
You train with fair accuracy
A mark has joined my top
I await the second one
I will not dodge at all
As many times as you like
You have not struck yet
I am set here and waiting
You need not aim at me
My top is right here
That last one was a little off

lines.zh: 我等着它第二下拍下来
lines.en: I wait for its second strike to fall.
I neither move nor dodge
The one in your hand seems eager
Come again while you have strength
I wait on your next blow
Do you need a rest
My legs have not loosened
I have no hands to strike with
I cannot hit back at all
Your blow lands on me
A mark stays on my top
That one landed solidly
I hold steady again
The wood sounds once
I have no strength to answer
Your hand jars from it
That was heavier than the last
I have no way to answer
I take another blow
Someone set me in this room
I turn from an item into a table
My four legs meet the floor
A table joins the middle of the room
I am set in position
The floor sounds once
I stand, facing the door
My top is still clean

lines.zh: 这间屋子开始像一个训练场
lines.en: This room starts to look like a training ground
I do not rock as I settle
I come out of a pack
I am here for someone to come
Fire blackens one corner of me
I knock against the ground on landing
Water makes my wood heavy
The blast tips me over
An arrow sticks in my top

lines.zh: 咒光在我面上烧出一圈
lines.en: Magic burns a ring into my top
I live on training, not on meals.
Lightning runs along the wood
I fall, still facing up
